# A round item whose base branch the remote lacks ends before its workflow file runs. The error names the base and the fix.
isolate

exec git init -q -b main origin
exec git -C origin add readme.txt
exec git -C origin -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m start

fixture project.star config/projects/local.star
replace config/projects/local.star '~/work/your-repo' $WORK/origin
subst flow/round.star

exec beehavereal item add local round/release/none --title 'The round' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run round/release/none local --workflow flow/round.star
stderr 'base branch "release/none" of round item round/release/none'
stderr 'Push the base branch to the remote, then run the item again'
! exists before.pwd
! exists state/trees/local/round_2Frelease_2Fnone

-- body.txt --
The round of the base.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- flow/round.star --
def main(item):
    command(name = "before", run = ["sh", "-c", "pwd > @WORK@/before.pwd"])
